legend: Distal-type bronchiolar adenoma resembling distal bronchiolar epithelium. This tumour is composed of bland luminal cuboidal epithelial cells overlying a continuous basal cell layer.

legend: Proximal-type bronchiolar adenoma / ciliated muconodular papillary tumour shows abundant ciliated and mucinous cells overlying a continuous layer of basal cells.

diagnosis: Bronchiolar adenoma / ciliated muconodular papillary tumour

diagnosis: Bronchiolar adenoma / ciliated muconodular papillary tumour
legend: This peripheral subpleural bronchiolar adenoma forms a nodular proliferation of bronchiolar-type epithelial cells overlying thickened alveolar walls, with a moderate lymphoid infiltrate. Airspaces are filled with mucin but the tumour shows mostly flat rather than papillary surfaces.

diagnosis: Bronchiolar adenoma / ciliated muconodular papillary tumour
legend: A peribronchiolar papillary tumour surrounded by abundant mucus.

legend: Micropapillary tufts (shown here) and skipping growth (shown in Fig. <<#14828>>) are common and should not be mistaken for malignant features.
